infrastructure_project_type.label: Infrastructure project type
infrastructure_project_type.value: Aerial and underground fiber networks, wireless networks, underground utility locating, and electric and gas utility construction.

public_private_client_mix.label: Public / private client mix
public_private_client_mix.value: Primarily private-sector telecommunications service providers, with additional work for electric and gas utilities.

contracted_backlog.label: Contracted backlog
contracted_backlog.value: Backlog includes estimated future work under master service agreements and other contracts.

heavy_equipment_model.label: Heavy-equipment model
heavy_equipment_model.value: Owned and leased vehicles and construction equipment.

fixed_price_cost_overrun_exposure.label: Fixed-price / cost-overrun exposure
fixed_price_cost_overrun_exposure.value: Primarily unit-priced contracts, with exposure when actual delivery costs exceed the agreed unit prices.

concession_operating_commitments.label: Concession / operating commitments
concession_operating_commitments.value: Turn-key and standard telecommunications projects, ongoing network maintenance and service, and emergency restoration.

notes: The public-sector share of the client mix is unclear.
